tests.name: OP_VERIFY stack presence test (zero followed by 01)
OP_NOT success (multi-byte non-zero becomes empty string)
OP_0NOTEQUAL success (explicit empty string becomes empty)
OP_0NOTEQUAL success (only last byte non-zero becomes 01)
OP_2DUP success (stack total size exactly 8000000 including altstack)
OP_2DUP fail (stack total size including altstack equals 8000001)
OP_DUP3 success (stack total size exactly 8000000 including altstack)
OP_IFDUP success (last byte non-zero triggers duplication)
OP_IFDUP success (duplication puts stack+altstack exactly at 8000000)
OP_PICK success (0xff treated as large index, fails as out-of-bounds)
OP_ROLL fail (ff interpreted as large index)
OP_BOOLAND success (both multi-byte zero) FIXME (why is this true?)
OP_BOOLAND success (one non-zero at the end)
OP_BOOLOR success (both multi-byte zero) FIXME (why is this true?)
OP_NUMEQUAL success (equal long values with trailing zeros)
OP_NUMEQUAL success (equal after trimming trailing zeros)
OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY success (long equal with trailing zeros)
OP_NUMNOTEQUAL success (one empty, one padded zero = equal)
